page.notes: The footnote text is set in small type and was transcribed as printed. The superscript mark "q" in the text is the reference mark for the final footnote line. Hyphenated line-end words in the main text were rejoined with their printed hyphens ("apos-tata" written as "apostata" with the hyphen removed at the line end). The "they" superscript is rendered as printed. Some faint show-through from the reverse side is present and was ignored.
